rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=40, batch_size=4, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1080, seed=42, rationale=FRESH search-20260619-01 iter-1 FEASIBILITY under the corrected protocol (val=ALL 214 L277 slices + 321px detector-geometry FOV; HARD 20-min train+score budget). Hammernik-2017 here is an IMAGE-DOMAIN variational net that denoises the FBP -- NO projector inside the unrolled loop, so each forward is far cheaper than LPD (which ran the PYRO-NN projector in-loop and still did train200+score214 in 1149s/19.2min). That cheapness is spent on CONVERGENCE not capacity, to dodge the LPD trap (under-trained heavy unrolled net -> hr=0 @ SSIM 0.843). Capacity modest: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16 (below the 24 default for a cheaper RBF activation loop), vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31; vn_lambda_init=2.3e-3 = the documented VN-port working corner (LOOSE hint, not validated). Training favors convergence: epochs=40, train_n=200, batch=4, lr=5e-4, grad_clip=1.0; max_train_s=1080 (18min) in-solver wall trips before the 30min SLURM kill, leaving headroom for score(214)+figure. Hyp: a budget-sized, ACTUALLY-CONVERGED Hammernik-2017 lands near or above the ~0.84 LD-FBP-ish SSIM floor within 20 min on Mayo; if even at 40 epochs it stays stuck at hr=0 with lambda_t barely budging (the documented 2026-06-08 failure signature), that is the iter-1 feasibility finding -- a shared-filter-bank structural ceiling, not a config knob away.

hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=14, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=search-20260619-01 iter-2 OOM RESCUE of hammernik_2017. iter-1 (batch_size=4) was NOT a real recon: it CUDA-OOMed in the _rho_prime RBF-bump loop at elapsed_s=72.5 on a 16GB RTX5000 (val_score blank in results.tsv), recorded as 0.0. The (B,F,H,W)=(4,16,512,512) x 31-bump RBF activation tensors held across 5 unrolled steps for autograd blew the card. SINGLE COHERENT memory-safety change for this rescue: batch_size 4->2, which halves every per-batch activation tensor in the bump loop -- the direct cause. NOTE: this hammernik_2017 solver is a PURE IMAGE-DOMAIN denoiser of the FBP (no projector in the unrolled loop) and does NOT read vn_checkpoint or vn_dc_norm (verified by grep over every cfg[...]/cfg.get(...) in the solver: only vn_T/vn_n_filters/vn_kernel/vn_n_bumps/vn_x_range/vn_*_init_std/vn_lambda_init/epochs/batch_size/lr/grad_clip/train_n/val_n/seed/max_train_s are consumed). Those two knobs belong to the SIBLING projector-in-loop hammernik_vn solver; passing them here would be silently ignored, so they are intentionally omitted -- the operative fix this solver honors is the batch halving (+ grad_clip=1.0 already present for VN-family NaN-skip stability). Budget: HARD 20-min train+score; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (321px detector-geometry FOV default, no fov= override; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps, bg_target=truth). batch=2 ~doubles steps/epoch, so epochs 40->14 (mirrors the sibling hammernik_vn iter-1 that scored 0.805 in 1296s); max_train_s=1000 (16.7min in-solver wall) is the binding constraint and leaves ~3min for score(214)+figure under the 30min SLURM kill. capacity kept modest (vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16). HYPOTHESIS: with batch halved the activation footprint drops ~2x, the OOM is avoided, hammernik_2017 produces its FIRST FINITE recon landing near/above the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor (sibling hammernik_vn hit 0.805) -- the first valid datapoint for this solver under the corrected metric.

ONE KNOB: vn_lambda_init 0.0023 -> 0.05 (~22x DC-weight init). All else held at iter-2 (vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, epochs=14, batch_size=2, lr=5e-4, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42). PRIOR (NUMBERS, corrected metric): iter-1 OOM at batch_size=4 (no recon, hr=0, elapsed 72s); iter-2 = FIRST valid datapoint, val_ssim=0.80123 hr=0 (PSNR 33.91, RMSE 0.00101, baseline_PSNR 34.08 so LD-FBP floor SSIM ~0.84; iter-2 is BELOW the FBP floor), elapsed 887s (train 789.7s, ~5 min budget headroom under the 30-min SLURM kill). iter-1->iter-2 = the first finite point; this is hammernik_2017's first real number under the corrected metric and it sits below baseline. DIAGNOSIS from iter-2 SLURM log 765262: training CONVERGED (loss 2.5e-4 ep1 -> 8.7e-7 ep14, flat by ep5) so epochs-up is INERT (NOT under-training); and CRITICALLY lambda_t stayed pinned at ['0.0023','0.00231','0.00232','0.00232','0.00233'] across ALL 14 epochs -- Adam never grew the learnable DC weight from its init. This solver is PURE IMAGE-DOMAIN: the unrolled update is y <- y - K^T*rho'(K*y) - lam*(y - y_NN) (solver line 141), so lam pulls the recon toward the FBP init y_NN. With lam ~0.0023 the learned-regulariser gradient K^T*rho' dominates the FBP-anchor term, so the VN over-smooths the FBP init DOWN below the ~0.84 baseline (val_ssim 0.80 < FBP). LIMITER = DC weight too small (NOT capacity, NOT epochs). Since lambda_t never moves from init, the init vn_lambda_init IS the lever. vn_lambda_init 0.0023 -> 0.05 makes the FBP-anchor term ~22x stronger so the recon stays pinned near the FBP init instead of being smoothed below it. lr held (campaign record: lr5e-4 optimal, 8e-4 worse for the VN family). HYPOTHESIS: with the DC anchor ~22x stronger, val_ssim clears the ~0.84 FBP floor and hr>0 (predict val_ssim > 0.84). FALSIFIER: if val_ssim stays <=0.84 (still <FBP) the shared-filter-bank regulariser is structurally degrading even under a strong FBP anchor, and iter-4 must attack the regulariser itself (drop vn_n_filters or shrink x_range / tighten the RBF activation) rather than the DC weight. BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): the lambda VALUE does not change per-step compute (same image-domain conv + RBF-bump loop), so cost ~= iter-2: train ~790s + ~100s score(214)+figure ~= 890s, well under the 1800s SLURM kill. MEMORY-SAFE: identical footprint to iter-2 -- batch_size=2 (KEPT, do NOT raise: bs=4 OOMed the 16GB card in the _rho_prime RBF-bump loop at iter-1) + N_k=16 + 31-bump activation across 5 unrolled steps stays within 16 GB. grad_clip=1.0 retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability).
